title: 2002 HMMT February Guts Problem 3
statement: How many elements are in the set obtained by transforming \(\{(0,0),(2,0)\} 14\) times?

solutions.text: Transforming it \(k \geq 1\) times yields the diamond \(\{(n, m):|n-1|+|m| \leq k+1\}\) with the points \((1, k),(1, k+1),(1,-k),(1,-k-1)\) removed (this can be seen inductively). So we get \((k+1)^{2}+k^{2}-4\) lattice points, making the answer 477 .
